Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Your Pest Control Custom Values

Referral Campaign Offer

Input the offer for your referral campaign. This will seamlessly integrate into your referral offer workflow, encouraging satisfied customers to refer new clients to your pest control business.

DR Campaign Offer

Add the offer for your (DR) campaign. This value will automatically update within your DR campaign workflow, ensuring consistent and compelling offers are presented to potential leads.

Funnel Offer

Update this value to include a specific offer for any funnels that dont have an offer.

Google Review Link (Continuous Reputation Management)

Insert the Google review link for your pest control business. This link will facilitate continuous reputation management automation, helping you maintain and enhance your online reputation.

Google Review Link (Review Campaign)

Add the same Google review link here for your pest control business. This link will be used in the review campaign to gather feedback and reviews from your customers, boosting your online presence.

Holiday Email Offer

Customize the offer you wish to run within the 13 beautifully designed holiday emails. This allows you to provide seasonal promotions and special offers, keeping your business top-of-mind for customers during the holidays.

Free Quote/Inspection Calendar Link

Add your free quote or inspection calendar link here. This will be utilized in various automations, making it easy for potential customers to schedule appointments with your pest control business.

Service Area

Specify the service area for your pest control business. This ensures that all communications and marketing efforts are targeted to the appropriate geographical locations, optimizing your reach and effectiveness.

By setting up these custom values, you ensure that your pest control business's workflows and campaigns are tailored to your specific needs, maximizing efficiency and customer engagement.

2. Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

In our pest control snapshot, you'll find three distinct pipelines tailored to streamline your sales processes:

Review Campaign Pipeline

The review campaign pipeline allows you to manage all your review requests sent through your review campaign. It enables you to track how many customers left a review versus those who didn't. The stages in this pipeline include:

Request Sent

Review Link Clicked

Link Not Clicked

Database Reactivation Campaign Pipeline

This pipeline is designed to manage leads generated from your database reactivation campaigns. It helps you track and nurture these leads through the various stages of the sales cycle. The stages in this pipeline include:

Offer Sent

Lead Responded

Not Interested

Appointment Booked

Main Pest Control Leads Pipeline

The main pest control leads pipeline serves as the central hub for managing all your pest control leads. Whether they come from website forms, web chats, or other sources, this pipeline enables you to organize, track, and prioritize these leads effectively to maximize conversion opportunities. The stages in this pipeline include:

New Lead

Hot Lead (Lead Responded)

Free Quote / Inspection Appointment Booked

Appointment Canceled

Appointment No Show

Customer Sold

Not Interested

Customer Canceled Services

Customer Refunded

With these three automated pipelines at your disposal, you can efficiently manage your sales activities, nurture leads, and drive revenue growth for your pest control business.

3. Calendars

Automated calendars are powerful tools that streamline scheduling processes, improve organization, and enhance productivity for businesses. They automate the process of booking appointments, managing service schedules, and coordinating activities, allowing businesses to efficiently allocate resources and provide exceptional service to their customers.

Snapshot Automated Calendars

In the pest control snapshot, you'll find two specialized automated calendars designed to simplify scheduling and streamline customer interactions:

Service Calendar

The Service Calendar is dedicated to managing all service-related appointments for your pest control business. This calendar allows you to schedule routine service tasks, follow-up visits, and ongoing maintenance appointments efficiently. Key features include:

Automated Booking: Customers can easily book service appointments online.

Appointment Management: Keep track of all scheduled services and allocate resources effectively.

Customer Notifications: Automated email and text notifications to remind customers of upcoming appointments.

Free Quote / Inspection / Discovery Calendar

The Free Quote / Inspection / Discovery Calendar is specifically tailored to handle initial consultations and discovery appointments with new leads and potential customers. This calendar helps streamline the process of providing free quotes and inspections. Key features include:

Lead Capture: Seamlessly capture new leads by allowing potential customers to book free quote or inspection appointments online.

Pipeline Integration: Automatically update the sales pipeline when appointments are booked, ensuring seamless lead management.

Customer Engagement: Send automated email and text reminders to ensure leads are prepared for their scheduled appointments.

These automated calendars help ensure that your pest control business runs smoothly by providing a structured and efficient way to manage appointments and customer interactions.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Understanding Appointment Automation

Automated appointment management systems streamline the process of scheduling, confirming, and managing appointments for businesses. By leveraging automation, businesses can enhance efficiency, improve customer communication, and reduce no-show rates, ultimately maximizing productivity and customer satisfaction.

Snapshot Appointment Automation

In the pest control snapshot, we offer comprehensive automation for appointment confirmation, reminders, no-shows, and cancellations. Here's how it works:

Appointment Confirmation: When someone books an appointment on either calendar, they will receive an automated confirmation email or text message, ensuring that their appointment is successfully scheduled and confirmed.

Appointment Reminders: Prior to the scheduled appointment, automated reminders will be sent to the customer to minimize the risk of no-shows and ensure that they are prepared and ready for their appointment.

No-show Management: In the event of a no-show, the system will automatically tag the customer accordingly, allowing you to follow up and reschedule as needed to minimize disruptions to your schedule and workflow.

Cancellation Handling: If a customer cancels their appointment, the system will update their status accordingly. For example, on the free quote/inspection Calendar, if they book an appointment, they will be updated as "appointment booked" in the pipeline. If they cancel, their status will be updated to "canceled," and if they fail to show up for the appointment, they will be marked as "no show" in the pipeline.

5. Link Trees

Linktrees are powerful tools that allow businesses to consolidate multiple links into a single, easy-to-navigate landing page. This is especially useful for directing traffic from social media platforms, email signatures, and other digital marketing channels to various resources, offers, and contact points. For pest control businesses, linktrees can help streamline customer interactions, gather leads, and provide essential information.

Snapshot Linktrees

In the pest control snapshot, you'll find four specialized linktrees designed to cater to different marketing objectives and customer interactions:

Pest Control Call Us Linktree

The Pest Control Call Us Linktree is designed to make it easy for potential customers to get in touch with your business directly. Key features include:

Direct Contact Link: A prominent call-to-action button that directs visitors to call your pest control business.

Business Information: Essential details such as business hours, phone number, and address.

Service Overview: Brief descriptions of the pest control services offered, encouraging visitors to reach out for more information.

Pest Control Lead Magnet Linktree

The Pest Control Lead Magnet Linktree is aimed at capturing leads by offering valuable resources in exchange for contact information. Key features include:

Lead Capture Form: An embedded form to collect visitor information such as name, email, and phone number.

Free Resource: An enticing lead magnet, such as a free eBook on pest prevention tips or a discount voucher for first-time customers.

Follow-Up: Automated integration with your CRM to follow up with captured leads through email or phone.

Pest Control Schedule A Call Us Linktree

The Pest Control Schedule A Call Us Linktree is focused on allowing potential customers to schedule a consultation or service call. Key features include:

Scheduling Link: Direct link to your Free Quote / Inspection / Discovery Calendar, allowing visitors to book appointments online.

Service Descriptions: Information about the types of consultations and services available.

Contact Options: Additional options for visitors to call or email your business directly.

Pest Control Video Linktree

The Pest Control Video Linktree leverages video content to engage visitors and provide valuable information about your pest control services. Key features include:

Embedded Video: Showcase a high-quality video that highlights your services, customer testimonials, or educational content about pest control.

Call-to-Action: Encourage visitors to take action after watching the video, such as scheduling a service or contacting your business.

Additional Links: Provide links to other resources, such as your website, service pages, or social media profiles.

Customization

Each of these linktrees can be customized to align with the pest control business’s branding and marketing goals.

6. Funnels

Funnels are strategic marketing tools designed to guide potential customers through a series of steps, from initial awareness to conversion. For pest control businesses, funnels can be highly effective in attracting, engaging, and converting leads by offering valuable incentives and clear calls-to-action.

Snapshot Funnels

In the pest control snapshot, you'll find three specialized funnels tailored to different marketing objectives and customer needs:

$100 Off Any Service Funnel

The $100 Off Any Service Funnel is designed to attract leads by offering a significant discount on pest control services. Key features include:

Landing Page: Highlights the $100 discount offer, detailing eligible services and how customers can take advantage of the promotion.

Lead Capture Form: Collects visitor information such as name, email, and phone number to qualify leads.

Follow-Up: Automated follow-up emails and texts to remind leads of the offer and encourage them to book a service.

2 Step Funnel

The 2 Step Funnel is designed to capture leads effectively and drive them towards booking a service. This funnel is easily customizable with an offer using custom values. Key features include:

Step 1 - Lead Capture Page: Collects essential information from visitors (name, email, phone number) and presents an enticing offer.

Step 2 - Thank You Page: Confirms submission and provides additional information or a next step, such as scheduling a consultation or service.

Customizable Offer: Easily update the offer through custom values to reflect current promotions or special deals.

Pyros Funnel

The Pyros Funnel is a comprehensive, multi-step funnel designed to engage leads with video content and guide them towards booking an appointment. This funnel is also customizable with a special offer using custom values. Key features include:

Video Page: Engages visitors with a high-quality video that highlights your pest control services, customer testimonials, or educational content about pest prevention.

Calendar Page: Provides an easy way for visitors to schedule a service or consultation directly through your calendar.

Thank You Page: Confirms the appointment and provides any additional information or next steps.

Customizable Offer: Easily add a special offer through custom values to enhance the attractiveness of the funnel.

Customization

Each funnel can be customized to align with your pest control business’s branding and marketing goals. By using custom values, you can easily update offers and other key elements to ensure your funnels remain relevant and compelling. This flexibility allows you to optimize your marketing efforts and effectively convert leads into customers.

Funnel Automations:

Each funnel will be fully automated, with the name of each automation matching the corresponding funnel. Similarly, the funnel forms will be named identically for easy organization. When someone opts into a funnel, they will be seamlessly updated in the sales pipeline, tagged appropriately, and trigger an internal notification for you. Additionally, the lead will receive a personalized text and email with their offer upon opting in. If they proceed to book an appointment through the funnel, the appointment reminder automations will be triggered.

It's important to note that each automation and text message can be easily customized to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a cohesive and personalized experience for your leads.

7. 52 Week Nurture Campaigns

In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive 52-week email and text pest control nurture campaigns designed to cultivate relationships with your leads and keep your pest control business top-of-mind. Here's what you can expect:

52-Week Email Nurture Campaign: This campaign consists of a series of weekly emails delivered to your pest control leads over the course of a year. Each email contains valuable tips, industry insights, and exclusive offers tailored to their needs and interests. The goal of this campaign is to keep your pest control business front and center in the minds of your leads while providing them with ongoing value and engagement.

52-Week Text Nurture Campaign: Similarly, the 52-week text nurture campaign delivers weekly text messages to your pest control leads, keeping them informed and engaged with the pest control business. These texts may include quick tips, special promotions, or reminders about upcoming events or services. The goal is to maintain regular communication with your leads through a convenient and accessible channel, fostering a sense of connection and trust.

Benefits of pest control Nurture Campaigns

Long-Term Relationship Building: By delivering consistent value and engagement over an extended period, nurture campaigns help to build strong relationships with your leads, positioning your pest control business as a trusted and reliable partner.

Increased Engagement: Regular communication through emails and text messages keeps your pest control business top-of-mind and encourages ongoing interaction with your leads, increasing engagement and retention rates.

Customizable Content: You have the flexibility to customize the content of both the emails and text messages to align with your branding, messaging, and marketing objectives. Whether it's sharing educational content, promoting special offers, or inviting leads to events, you can tailor the campaigns to suit your unique business needs.

With our 52-week email and text pest control nurture campaigns, you can stay connected with your leads, provide them with valuable insights and offers, and nurture them towards conversion over the long term.

8. Database Reactivation

Understanding Database Reactivation Campaigns

Database reactivation campaigns are strategic marketing initiatives aimed at re-engaging with inactive or lapsed leads in your database. These campaigns help revitalize your contact list, rekindle interest in your products or services, and ultimately drive conversions. In our snapshot, we offer two types of database reactivation campaigns: a basic version and an advanced version, each offering unique features and functionalities.

Snapshot Database Reactivation Campaigns

Basic Database Reactivation Campaign: The basic campaign provides a straightforward approach to reactivating dormant leads in your database. You have the flexibility to customize the offer for this campaign using a custom value. This campaign aims to reconnect with inactive leads, remind them of your value proposition, and encourage them to re-engage with your business.

Advanced Database Reactivation Campaign (DR Campaign): The advanced campaign takes database reactivation to the next level by incorporating dynamic lead management features. Similar to the basic campaign, you can customize the offer using a custom value. However, this campaign goes a step further by updating leads in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline. If a lead responds positively to the campaign, they will be moved to a "responded" status in the pipeline, indicating active interest. Conversely, if they indicate disinterest, they will be moved to a "not interested" status, allowing you to focus your efforts on more promising leads.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the pest control business. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Email Workflow: The email workflow is activated when a lead reaches out via email. Similar to the GMB message workflow, it tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the pest control business, ensuring a prompt and efficient response to email inquiries.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the pest control business, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the pest control business, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

12. Reputation Management

Reputation management is crucial for maintaining a positive image and credibility for your pest control business. It involves actively monitoring and influencing how your brand is perceived by customers, both online and offline. In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive reputation management features to help you proactively manage and enhance your online reputation.

Snapshot Reputation Management Features

Ongoing Reputation Management: After each service, customers have the option to request a review. This process allows you to gather feedback and testimonials from satisfied customers, helping to boost your online reputation and credibility.

Google Review Campaign: Our Google review campaign is designed to generate a significant number of new reviews for your pest control business. You can input a list of existing customers into the campaign to kickstart the process, resulting in 30-100 new reviews right away. Customers in this campaign are managed through a dedicated review campaign pipeline, allowing you to track who has left a review and who hasn't.

Key Features and Customization Options

Custom Review Links: The review link for both ongoing reputation management and the Google review campaign can be customized using custom values. This allows you to tailor the review links to your branding and preferences.

Trigger Links: Each campaign includes two trigger links that serve as indicators of customer engagement. These trigger links, associated with the review custom value links, help you track whether customers have clicked on the review links or not, if clicked they will no longer get review reminders and so on.

13. Invoice Reminders, Cancellation, & Refunds

Automation for invoice management streamlines the process of handling invoices, reminders, cancellations, and refunds, ensuring smooth and efficient financial transactions for your pest control business. These automated workflows help you stay organized, reduce administrative burden, and provide a seamless experience for your customers.

Snapshot Automation for Invoice Management

Invoice Reminders Automation: This automation sends timely reminders to customers who have outstanding invoices, prompting them to make payment. By automating invoice reminders, you can minimize late payments, improve cash flow, and maintain positive relationships with your customers.

Cancelation Automation: When a customer cancels a service or appointment, this automation ensures that the cancellation process is handled smoothly and efficiently. It updates the customer's status, triggers any necessary refunds, and notifies relevant stakeholders, allowing you to manage cancellations with ease and professionalism.

Refunds Automation: In cases where refunds are warranted, this automation handles the refund process seamlessly. It initiates the refund, updates the customer's status accordingly, and provides notifications to both the customer and your team, ensuring transparency and accountability in the refund process.

Key Features and Customization Options

Timely Notifications: Each automation sends timely notifications to customers and stakeholders, keeping them informed throughout the invoicing, cancellation, and refund processes.

Customizable Messaging: You have the flexibility to customize the messaging of each automation to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a consistent and professional experience for your customers.

14. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact your pest control business but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your business. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with your pest control business.

Call to Action: The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
